correctness.rationale: The frozen attribution conflates Proposition 4.1's starting δ=2 germ and its one-cusp alternative with Theorem 4.2's proof, which actually starts with ordinary cusps and claims two nodes per cusp. The repair distinguishes the two, and limits its refutation to the asserted mechanisms, not the closure/codimension statement. Independently reconstructing the two normalization quotients gives codimension one in each (missing the s monomial for the cusp; a one-dimensional difference of constant terms for the node). Additivity and δ constancy therefore exclude both a lone ordinary cusp as a δ=2 alternative and two nodes per cusp in the δ-constant setting without compensating contributions. With κ ordinary cusps and no other singularities any nodal member of that stratum necessarily has κ nodes. No numerical proof or external certificate is required.
